message:
feat(keepalive-r2 ②, c/e): a lease's capability from the directory through its OWN socket (product form)

standby_directory.hpp: standby_observe_on(socket, ...) sends the rendezvous' OBSERVE datagram from the lease's socket
(the relay binds a standby lease to the endpoint its observation came from, contract §2.7); standby_directory_capability
does that, then directory_connect(standby), then aims at the relay when this connect reserved one, else at the host
(the first private candidate, else the first listed -- no NAT punch here: a path that needs one is not reached and the
lease stays unadmitted, bounded). The e2e's relay leases now use it instead of the test's own observe + connect: 61/61
under sh_run -NativeExe (--real-directory --old-host).
Shipping: nothing in the apps calls it yet.
